title: Weak cipher named (universal) — review required
description: Configuration or code names a weak cipher: b(?:RC4|3DES|DES-CBC|Blowfish)b. RC4, single DES, and 3DES are broken or deprecated for protecting data. This lexical rule flags the name; the reviewer confirms it is documentation or removes it.
remediation: Negotiate AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305 suites and drop the weak name.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the name regardless of context.
